p: art my God: Thus the prophet gives thanks to God because he will bring under subjection these nations by his corrections, and make them of his Church, who before were his enemies.
city an heap: Not only of Jerusalem, but also of these other cities which have been your enemies.
of foreigners to be no city: That is, a place where all vagabonds may live without danger and as it were at ease as in a palace.
strong people glorify thee: The arrogant and proud who before would not know you will by your corrections fear and glorify you.
of the terrible ones is as: The rage of the wicked is furious, till God breaks the force of it.
heat in a dry place: Meaning, that as the heat is abated by the rain, so shall God bring down the rage of the wicked.
even the heat with the shadow: As a cloud shades from the heat of the sun, so God will assuage the rejoicing of the wicked against the godly.

mountain shall the LORD of hosts: That is, in Zion, by which he means his Church, which would under Christ be assembled of the Jews and the Gentiles, and is here described under the figure of a costly banquet, as in Mt 22:2.
the face of the covering cast: Meaning, that ignorance and blindness, by which we are kept back from Christ.
wipe away tears from off all: He will take away all opportunity for sorrow and fill his with perfect joy, Rev 7:17,21:4.
Moab shall be trodden down under: By Moab are meant all the enemies of his Church.
dunghill: There were two cities by this name: one in Judah, 1Ch 6:81 and another in the land of Moab, Jer 48:2 which seems to have been a plentiful place of corn, Isa 36:17.
